units.source_text: 我觉得有为子生前就是自由地出人于这种双重的世界。

en.t: I think that while she was alive, Uiko moved freely in and out of this double world.

units.source_text: 发生那次悲剧性的事件时，也以为她要拒绝这个世界，可是接着她又接受了这个世界。

en.t: When that tragic incident occurred, I thought she was going to reject this world, but then she accepted it again.

units.source_text: 对于有为子来说，也许死是偶然的事件。

en.t: For Uiko, perhaps death was an accidental event.

units.source_text: 她在金刚院的渡殿上留下的血，也许只不过像早晨打开窗户时飞起来的蝴蝶落在窗框上的磷粉一样。

en.t: The blood she left on the covered passageway of Kongoin may have been no more than the powder from a butterfly's wings, shaken loose onto the window frame when the window was opened in the morning.
